description:
## What

Three small dead-code removals discovered in a recent code-review pass:

1. `src/fetcher/rate_limiter_registry.cr` — `record Entry, limiter : TokenBucketRateLimiter, last_accessed : Time, ttl : Time::Span` is defined but never referenced anywhere in the codebase. (The actual storage lives in `RateLimiterStore`.)

2. `src/fetcher/circuit_breaker.cr` — `record RegistryEntry, breaker : CircuitBreaker, last_accessed : Time, ttl : Time::Span` defined inside `CircuitBreaker` class. Never referenced. (The actual storage lives in `CircuitBreakerStore`.)

3. `src/fetcher/url_validator.cr` — `LINK_LOCAL_IPV4 = "169.254.0.0/16"` and `LINK_LOCAL_IPV6 = "fe80::/10"` constants are defined but never used. The actual IP-range checks use the per-octet constants (`IPV4_LINK_LOCAL_FIRST_OCTET` etc.) instead.

## Why

Dead code adds visual noise, increases the surface for future confusion, and signals 'maybe this is important' when it isn't.

## How

Delete the dead definitions. No callers will break (verified via grep).

## Done when

- Three definitions removed
- Full spec suite still green
- No new warnings from ameba/catseye
title: Cleanup: remove dead records and constants in registries
